description: Implementation of DeviceFiles class managing license storage, retrieval, and file handling with hashing and protobuf serialization in a DRM context.

classes.name: DeviceFiles
classes.description: Class handling storage, retrieval, and management of DRM license files with hashing and protobuf serialization.

methods.name: StoreLicense
methods.description: Stores a license with a specific state and response, serializing and hashing the data.

methods.name: RetrieveLicense
methods.description: Retrieves and verifies a license file, returning its state and content.

methods.name: DeleteLicense
methods.description: Deletes a specific license file based on keySetId.

methods.name: LicenseExists
methods.description: Checks if a license file exists for a given keySetId.

methods.name: ListLicenses
methods.description: Lists all stored license key IDs.

methods.name: RetrieveHashedFile
methods.description: Reads, verifies hash, and deserializes a hashed file.

methods.name: GetFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a specified file.
